name: codefori-cli
description: Programmatic bridge enabling external automation, shell scripts, and AI agents to invoke Code for IBM i actions, manage IFS deployments, and trigger builds.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.port.description: Port for the HTTP Bridge server (0 for ephemeral dynamic port allocation).

code-for-ibmi-bridge.autoStart.description: Automatically start the Bridge HTTP server upon extension activation.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect: Prefer npm package (@rishabkshk/codefori-cli) if installed, otherwise use Git Bash / POSIX curl script (Default).
npm: Use Node.js / npm CLI package (@rishabkshk/codefori-cli).
curl: Use zero-dependency Git Bash / POSIX curl script (codefori.sh).
code-for-ibmi-bridge.cliMode.markdownDescription: CLI interaction mode for Code for IBM i Bridge: `'auto'` prefers npm package if installed, otherwise uses Git Bash / POSIX curl script; `'npm'` forces the Node.js/npm package; `'curl'` forces the zero-dependency Git Bash / POSIX curl script.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.promptOnMissingNpm.description: Prompt the user regarding npm package installation when Node.js is detected on the system.

enumDescriptions: Require AI agent or client to request user confirmation in chat before execution (Default).
Strictly block all destructive commands automatically.
Display an interactive modal confirmation dialog in VS Code for user approval.
Permit execution of destructive commands without guardrail restrictions.
code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.policy.markdownDescription: Security policy for destructive commands: `'prompt'` asks agent to confirm in chat and pass `--confirm` flag (default), `'modal'` shows VS Code popup dialog, `'block'` automatically rejects, `'allow'` permits execution.

enumDescriptions: Strictly block all QSH shell commands and actions in QSH environment (Default).
Require AI agent or client to request user confirmation in chat before execution.
Display an interactive modal confirmation dialog in VS Code for user approval.
Permit execution of QSH commands and actions without restrictions.
code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.qshPolicy.markdownDescription: Security policy governing QSH commands and environments. `'block'` strictly disables QSH (default), `'prompt'` requires confirmation (`--confirm`), `'modal'` shows VS Code popup dialog, `'allow'` permits execution.

enumDescriptions: Require explicit confirmation (--confirm flag) for direct CL commands (Default).
Strictly block direct CL commands automatically.
Display an interactive modal confirmation dialog in VS Code for user approval.
Permit direct CL commands to execute without confirmation.
code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.clPolicy.markdownDescription: Security policy governing direct IBM i CL commands (`/run-cl`). `'prompt'` requires confirmation (`--confirm`) (default), `'block'` rejects direct CL commands, `'modal'` shows VS Code popup dialog, `'allow'` permits execution without confirmation. Predefined workspace actions are exempted.

enumDescriptions: Strictly block all direct PASE shell execution automatically (Default).
Require explicit confirmation (--confirm flag) for direct PASE shell execution.
Display an interactive modal confirmation dialog in VS Code for PASE shell execution.
Permit PASE shell execution without restrictions (subject to destructive command checks).
code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.pasePolicy.markdownDescription: Security policy governing IBM i PASE shell commands and environments. `'block'` strictly disables direct PASE shell execution (default), `'prompt'` requires confirmation (`--confirm`), `'modal'` shows VS Code popup dialog, `'allow'` permits execution.

enumDescriptions: Prioritize explicit file selection (select method) or require user confirmation with change list for blanket deploys (Default).
Display an interactive modal confirmation dialog in VS Code showing the list of changed files.
Strictly block blanket deployments; only targeted file deployments via select method are permitted.
Permit deployments without confirmation prompts.
code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.deployPoli.markdownDescription: Security policy governing workspace deployments to IBM i IFS. `'prompt'` requires file selection or user confirmation with the change list (default), `'modal'` shows VS Code dialog, `'block'` prohibits unselected deploys, `'allow'` permits deployment.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.promptTime.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for user confirmation before timing out and rejecting the command.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.customBloc.description: List of command names, prefixes, or regular expressions that are unconditionally blocked.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.customProm.description: List of additional command names, prefixes, or regular expressions that require interactive user confirmation.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.allowedCom.description: Whitelist of command patterns or prefixes exempt from destructive checks.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.enableActi.description: Inspect commands defined in actions (/run-action) for destructive patterns before running.

code-for-ibmi-bridge.security.requireCli.description: Block direct raw curl/HTTP access to the bridge server and require requests to originate from the official Code for IBM i CLI (codefori / codefori.sh).

code-for-ibmi-bridge.generateAgentDoc.description: Automatically generate or maintain an AGENTS.md helper guide in the active workspace root for AI coding agents.
